newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists makes no bids for Italian Btps.
newsitem.headline: Specialists makes no bids for Italian Btps.

text.p: Specialist bond traders made no bids for 250 billion lire of three-year and 250 billion of five year fixed-rate bonds (BTPs) offered by the Italian Treasury.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.736 trillion lire at the open auction for the three year paper, against 2.5 trillion lire worth of paper on offer. The auction price was set at 98.70 from 99.95 at the previous Btp sale.
The Treasury also received bids earlier for 2.864 trillion of five year Btps against 2.5 trillion on offer and the auction price was set at 98.15 from 99.75 at the previous sale on February 14.
